name: Ref-NeRF
aliases: Structured View-Dependent Appearance for Neural Radiance Fields
definition: A neural radiance field method that replaces NeRF's parameterization of view-dependent outgoing radiance with a representation of reflected radiance, structured using spatially-varying scene properties to improve specular reflection realism.
summary: Ref-NeRF improves specular reflection representation by decomposing radiance into diffuse and specular components using spatially-varying scene properties, enabling intuitive material editing.
